lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Fun Planet control, courier vessel requesting approach.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Lieutenant Leutenbord, Corporate Security. Transponder code, cargo manifest, and a smile. Fun is mandatory.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: This planet is owned, operated and thoroughly enjoyed by the Company. Please enjoy it within approved limits.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Approved fun includes the pools, the casino and the gift shop. Unapproved fun includes everything else.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: All deliveries are inspected. Anything that ticks, hums or looks at my officers funny gets confiscated.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Curfew is at 2200. The fireworks are at 2300. Yes, you must watch them from your ship. That is the rule.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Approach granted. Smile for the cameras, courier. There are a lot of them.

options.line: Is there really a curfew on Fun Planet?
